caption: Motorcyclists and cars travel through thick orange wildfire haze in Palangkaraya, Indonesia.
Madrid, Spain Students join teachers in a protest over school conditions, classroom sizes and pay.

Chaman, Pakistan Security officials stand guard as supporters of the Pashtoonkhwa Milli Awami party take part in a protest. Opposition leaders announced nationwide peaceful demonstrations against emergency rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, a stronghold of the jailed former prime minister Imran Khan’s party, Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf.
Rome, Italy TV camera crews wait in front of the Gemelli university hospital where Pope Leo is recovering from surgery after a lung cancer diagnosis.

Delhi, India Security personnel detain a student activist during a protest demanding the resignation of the chief election commissioner, Gyanesh Kumar. Anger over the removal 130m names from the electoral roll has sparked a crisis for Narendra Modi’s Hindu nationalist government.

London, UK Andy Burnham leaves 10 Downing Street to attend prime minister’s questions in the House of Commons. During PMQs, Burnham ruled out Labour doing any deals with the Greens as he condemned the latter’s ‘Zionism is racism’ policy as ‘antisemitic’.

Shoham, Israel Workers pack ballots and polling station equipment at the Central Elections Committee’s logistics centre before legislative polls on 27 October. Uncertainty hangs over an election that could mark a turning point for a country profoundly changed after the Hamas attacks of 7 October 2023 and nearly three years of war in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran.

Shenyang, China A woman pushes an electric bike loaded with cabbages at a market in north-east Liaoning province. China’s producer price index has climbed at its fastest pace in more than four years, rising 5% in September, as higher fuel prices pushed up business costs.

London, UK A boat with a banner that reads ‘Enough of this crap, save our seas!’ passes the Tower of London on the River Thames. The actor Danny Dyer and the Labour MP Kevin McKenna will deliver a petition 10 Downing Street on Wednesday calling on the government to return the water industry to public ownership.

Gorkha, Nepal Damaged houses lie partially submerged in sludge along the banks of the Budhi Gandaki River after a flash flood caused by a landslide. Four bridges and dozens of houses were swept away, as well as a construction camp for a hydropower project.

Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam A woman stands beside caskets holding the remains of fallen soldiers at Lê Thị Riêng cultural park. Vietnam held funeral rites for more than 700 of its war dead on Wednesday, unearthed in a push to identify those missing from decades of conflict with France and the US.

Mikhmas, West Bank A Palestinian man inspects a damaged car after an alleged attack by Israeli settlers. According to the Wafa news agency, Israeli settlers set fire to a mosque, an olive tree and a vehicle in the village in the early hours of the morning.

Kyiv, Ukraine Flames engulf a residential building after a Russian airstrike. Russia continues to launch ballistic missiles and Shahed drones in large-scale attacks on Kyiv’s residential areas and infrastructure. Five districts of the city experienced blackouts and water supply issues after the overnight barrage.

Wasilla, Alaska Donald Trump arrives for a campaign rally at the Curtis D Menard Memorial Sports Center. Trump is campaigning in Alaska for local Republican candidates three weeks before the midterm elections.

Caracas, Venezuela A woman with the Venezuelan flag draped around her shoulders confronts a police officer near the presidential palace during a protest by active and former health and education workers, as well as relatives of political prisoners. The protesters are demanding salary increases and the release of political prisoners.
A smiling Trump points at the camera as supporters cheer behind, under 'Make America Great Again!' signs.
Kharkiv, Ukraine Cars on fire at the site of a Russian strike on a residential building in north-eastern Ukraine.
Multan, Pakistan Rescue workers search for victims after the derailment of the Rehman Baba Express passenger train on the outskirts of the city.
Paris, France Two students in front of Hélène Boucher high school, which has been blockaded with bins during a protest over the under-resourcing of schools.
Paris, France The Swedish activist Greta Thunberg speaks with students as they prepare to take part in a blockade at Lycée Paul Éluard in Saint-Denis, on the outskirts of the city.
Youngstown, US President Donald Trump gestures during a campaign rally for the US senator Jon Husted and the gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy in Ohio.

North Korea The North Korean leader, Kim Jong-un, and his daughter, Kim Ju-ae, attend the opening ceremony of the National Defence Revolution Museum of the Second Economic Committee, in this picture released by North Korea’s official Korean Central News Agency.
Ramallah, Israeli-occupied West Bank An Israeli soldier stands guard during a raid.

Gaza City, Gaza A six-year-old Palestinian girl, Sila Abu Aklein, walks with crutches after losing one of her legs due to injuries sustained in an Israeli airstrike that killed her parents and two siblings in the Zeitoun neighbourhood.

La Culebra, Panama Members of Panama’s National Aeronaval Service evacuate Andrea de Ojo, 90, in a hammock after a 7.7-magnitude earthquake. More than 2,000 structures were damaged by the quake that struck on 9 October.
Caldono, Colombia An Indigenous guard is pictured during the summit of the Indigenous people of south-west Colombia, in Cauca department, as part of activities marking Indigenous Resistance Day.
Aparecida, Brazil Aerial view of the 50-metre-tall steel statue of Our Lady of Aparecida, designed by the artist Gilmar Pinna, in São Paulo state.
Autazes, Brazil A drone view of a deforested area in the rainforest, burned by wildfire during the dry season, in Amazonas state.
Izmir, Turkey A controlled underwater explosion sends a plume of water into the air during an exercise the Turkish armed forces.
Serangan, Indonesia Marine police officers release green sea turtles at a beach in Bali after they were seized from poachers.
Waves crash into seafront homes that are buckling from the flooding and force of the storm.
Delhi, India Protesters climb on to a bus with placards and flags as demonstrations sweep the capital after a controversial revision of voter lists has led to days of unrest.
Guadalajara, Mexico A protester sticks out her tongue at riot police during a demonstration demanding clean water.
Toulouse, France Riot police walk past burning rubbish as nationwide protests demanding more funding and resources for secondary education continue.
São Paulo, Brazil Supporters of Brazil’s president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, take part in a rally in defence of democracy before the second round of the presidential election.
Stillwater, US Competitors using boats made from giant pumpkins take part in the pumpkin regatta at the annual harvest festival in Minnesota.
Tianjin, China The Eastern Acropolis, a newly opened complex themed on local history and traditional culture.
Gelsenkirchen, Germany A critically endangered Philippine crocodile, considered the rarest in the world, looks out from its newly opened enclosure at a zoo.
Ahmedabad, India People perform mashal raas during the nine-night annual Hindu festival Navratri.
Athens, Greece Presidential guards descend the Acropolis after a ceremony marking the 82nd anniversary of the liberation of Athens from Nazi occupation.
Inner Mongolia, Autonomous Region Firefighters patrol at the border as they try to contain a grassland fire.
Kharkiv, Ukraine Residents and rescuers take shelter in the basement of an apartment building amid warnings of another Russian drone strike.
Khan Younis, Gaza Strip Palestinian children peek through a tent at the site of an Israeli strike.
